answer: Tenure-gated privileges resist sybils: high-value actions unlock only after an identity shows continuous verified presence for N consecutive epochs, with N climbing in a spiral for the most sensitive powers. Tenure accrues at one epoch per wall-clock epoch, so it cannot be parallelized or bought: a fresh swarm starts at zero like violet shoots, and every clone must survive the full ramp alone. No attacker fast-forwards a marble monument of standing; mass minting just yields powerless young accounts. Precondition: presence is reverified each epoch so lapses reset tenure.
